text: You want to exchange the helmet for a medium sized, red, high ventilation type, and you want to exchange the luggage set (in another order) to a two-piece black one with soft material. Lastly, you want to modify the grill you just ordered to the same type as the one you already received.
zh: 您想换一个中号、红色的、高通风类型的头盔，并且想换另一个订单里的行李套装为一个两件式的黑色软质行李套装。最后，您想将刚订购的格栅修改成与您已收到的同类型。
